entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-06-12
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Handle `#:project` directives in the IDE #78945
    .NET 10
  • Improve clarity/reliability of file-based program restore experience #78944
    .NET 10
  • Local SDK installation fails to use correct dotnet host #78939
  • [Enhancement] Warn when readonly dependencies are declared but not initialized in ASP.NET Core controllers or services #78936
  • IDE0051 (Remove unused private member) gets reported, when said member is used in ccode generated by an `IIncrementalGenerator` #78934
    Backlog
  • CSharp compiler breaks in nullable project if auto-generated "field" is used in a generic lambda #78932
    Next

Closed

  • Overload resolution in derived class fails because of generic method #78933
  • Unexpected behavior of `scoped` keyword with interface implementation #78711
    Next
  • workspace.OpenSolutionAsync locked after update code analysis libraries on vs 17.14 #78766
  • In SDK 8.0.2xx IDE0300 (collection expression) uses loose type matching which should not happen according to documentation #72532
    Backlog
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build feature.debugger.main-10711.180 #78935
  • Extensions: NullReferenceException when using local function #78913
  • Parameter Info stops working after pressing Ctrl+Shift+Space in a particular function call #76241
  • Expose synchronous SymbolFinder.FindSourceDefinition #76489
  • Integration Tests fails with assertion #66527
    Backlog
  • Intellisense information on generic extension method doesn't help for type arguments #78387
